picks.name: Shed
picks.source_note: Dekmantel Records already seeded. A different Shed EP on Ilian Tape ("Applications II") was previously confirmed stale; this is a separate, genuinely new-to-the-pool album on Dekmantel instead. Exact Bandcamp album-page link unconfirmable via search, so the purchase link uses the label's already-confirmed Bandcamp root.
picks.bio: "Rave Echoes" (May 2026, Dekmantel) is Shed's new album -- eight tracks ("Loot 25," "Everybody," "Rave Predator," two mixes of "Password," "Double Scoop," "Taking You Home," "Rave Echoes") mapping the afterglow of the rave rather than its peak.
picks.why_listen: A veteran Berlin techno producer's take on comedown/afterglow energy rather than peak-time -- useful for a set's later, more reflective stretch.
